spec.description:
Sisalation Vapawrap Residential Wall Wrap is a lightweight,
flexible Class 4 vapour-permeable wall wrap engineered for residential timber
and steel-framed homes, particularly in temperate and colder climate zones
(Zones 2 to 8). Constructed from a micro-porous breathable film laminated
between two layers of mould- and shrink-resistant spun-bonded polyolefin, it
allows internal moisture vapour to escape while acting as a barrier to liquid
water, wind, and dust. Available with up to 30 days (VP4-30) or 90 days (VP4-90)
UV resistance, it protects the structural frame and maximizes bulk insulation
efficiency.
features:
Class 4 Vapour Permeable membrane allowing internal
moisture vapour to escape

Acts as a secondary water barrier protecting frame
and insulation from driving rain

Effective air barrier minimising draughts
and improving thermal efficiency

Available with up to 30 days (VP4-30) or up
to 90 days (VP4-90) UV weather resistance

Engineered from resilient non-woven
polyolefin with high tear resistance

Suitable for use behind brick veneer,
fibre cement, weatherboard, and timber claddings

Micro-porous film resists
mould growth and moisture accumulation

Complies with AS/NZS 4200.1 as a water
barrier and vapour-permeable membrane

Suitable for bushfire-prone areas with
BAL ratings from 0 to FZ in accordance with AS 3959

Low flammability index
compliant with AS 1530.2

install:
Fix Vapawrap horizontally to exterior timber or steel studs
starting from the bottom plate

Fasten with broad-headed galvanized clouts or
staples at maximum 300mm centres

Overlap consecutive upper sheets over lower
sheets by minimum 150mm to shed water

Stagger vertical joints and ensure they
occur over studs with a minimum 150mm overlap

Tape all horizontal and
vertical seams with Sisalation VapaSeam Tape to form a continuous air barrier
Seal around window and door frames, sill flashings, and plumbing penetrations

Ensure a drained, ventilated cavity is maintained between the wrap and exterior
cladding
selection_checklist:
Confirm wall assembly requires a Class 4
breathable vapour-permeable membrane

Choose UV exposure rating (VP4-30 for 30
days or VP4-90 for 90 days construction exposure)

Select width (1350mm
or 1500mm) to suit framing height

Calculate roll count based on total wall
area allowing 150mm overlaps

Order matching Sisalation VapaSeam Tape (48mm
x 50m)
limitations:
Not suitable for roofing
applications (use Vapawrap Metal Roof)

Must not be left exposed to direct UV
sunlight beyond 30 days (VP4-30) or 90 days (VP4-90)

Ensure cladding
manufacturer requirements for cavity drainage are followed

retrieval.rag_summary:
Sisalation Vapawrap Residential Wall Wrap is a Class 4
vapour-permeable, Light Duty pliable building membrane designed for residential
timber and steel-framed walls. Manufactured from non-woven spunbond polyolefin
with a microporous breathable film, it prevents liquid water, drafts, and dust
penetration while permitting internal water vapour to escape. Available
in 1350mm and 1500mm widths with up to 30-day (VP4-30) or 90-day (VP4-90) UV
resistance and a Flammability Index ≤ 5 (BAL 0-FZ compliant), it prevents mould
and rot behind lightweight claddings and brick veneer.
